title: Leveraging Instruction Tuning and Merging for Reasoning Model Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2607.14895v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reasoning language models (RLMs) demonstrate impressive performance by leveraging test-time compute in the form of reasoning tokens. However, this behavior makes adapting RLMs to new domains challenging and expensive. The reason is that further training can disturb the learned behavior and degrade model performance. This makes it difficult to leverage supervised fine-tuning data with human-written solutions: although it contains high-quality annotations, it lacks reasoning tokens. In this work, we show how, despite this challenge, such data can be used efficiently for RLM adaptation. For this, we first use standard instruction tuning. Next, we leverage model merging to combine the instruction-tuned model with the original RLM, picking the merging ratio such that the resulting model's reasoning behavior on the target domain is recovered. We evaluate our method across four RLMs on coding and text summarization tasks, where it improves

translated_title: 利用指令微调与模型合并实现推理模型的领域适配
translated_abstract: 推理语言模型通过在测试时生成推理token，展现出了令人印象深刻的性能。然而，这种行为使得将推理模型适配到新领域变得困难且代价高昂。原因在于进一步的训练可能会干扰模型已学到的推理行为并导致性能下降。这使得难以利用包含人类撰写答案的监督微调数据：尽管这些数据包含高质量的标注，但缺乏推理token。在这项工作中，我们展示了尽管存在这一挑战，此类数据仍然可以高效地用于推理模型的适配。为此，我们首先使用标准的指令微调方法，然后利用模型合并技术将指令微调后的模型与原始推理模型相结合，并通过选择合适的合并比例来恢复所得模型在目标领域上的推理行为。我们在编程和文本摘要任务上对四个推理模型进行了评估，我们的方法能够提升……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出先指令微调再模型合并的两阶段方法，使缺乏推理token的人类标注数据能够高效地将推理语言模型适配到新领域，同时通过选择合适的合并比例保留原有的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a two-stage approach of instruction tuning followed by model merging, enabling efficient adaptation of reasoning language models to new domains using human-annotated data lacking reasoning tokens, while preserving reasoning behavior by carefully selecting the merging ratio.
